title: [Master]-Performance issue when calculating the VAT advance return / VAT statement (Base Application, German environment) - Copy
summary: Addresses a performance issue when calculating the VAT advance return or VAT statement by adding four lines to the VAT Entry table in both the CH and DACH Base Application layers.

Matching additions to table 254 VAT Entry in the DACH layer
